description:
Replaces the customer's page link. The existing link stops working the moment you call this endpoint, and Ottu does not tell the customer. Send the new `page_url` yourself, or the customer reaches a dead link. Use it to revoke a link that leaked or was lost, not to re-send a working one.

After a timeout, read the current link with Retrieve an AutoPay hosted-page link and compare its `page_url` with the one you hold before you retry. A blind retry can revoke a link you have just delivered.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Required. A UUID v4. Ottu rejects the call with `400` when the header is missing. The header does not make this call safe to repeat: replaying the same key still issues a new token and revokes the previous one.

parameters.name: subscription_id
parameters.description: AutoPay subscription identifier returned by subscription creation.

page_token.description: The new signed token. It replaces the previous one, which is now rejected.

page_url.description:
The complete link to hand to the customer. Ottu builds it from your primary domain, the subscription's language and `page_token`.

Anyone holding this link can act on the subscription, so treat it as a credential and deliver it only to the subscription's own customer. See [Customer Self-Service Page](/developers/payments/autopay/#customer-self-service-page).

schema.description: The newly issued self-service link. The previous link stopped working the moment it was replaced, and Ottu does not tell the customer, so you must deliver `page_url` yourself.

responses.description: The API key is missing or invalid. Send your private API key as `Authorization: Api-Key <your key>`.
No subscription with this id exists on your account. Do not retry.
Payments are paused on your Ottu account (`code: service_paused`), so the subscription endpoints are unavailable. Retry once payments are resumed.
The subscription service is unavailable. Retry with backoff.
The subscription service timed out, and a new link may already have been issued. Call page-link and compare `page_url` before retrying.
